### 1. Scene
A chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry in brown sauce over rice, accompanied by a small fruit bowl and orange juice. The meat appears to be chicken, although its identity and the sauce recipe are uncertain.

### 2. Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 25 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 12.5² = **491 cm²**.
- **Fruit bowl:** approximately 10 cm diameter; area = **79 cm²**.
- **Juice cup:** approximately 300 ml visibly filled.

### 3–7. Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
Coverage estimates partition the visible food footprint; sauce is counted separately rather than counted again over the other ingredients.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × average height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked rice | 22% of plate | 108 × 1.8 = 194 ml | 0.8 | 155 g | 130 | 202 kcal |
| Chicken pieces | 20% | 98 × 1.4 = 137 ml | 1.0 | 137 g | 165 | 226 kcal |
| Green beans, carrots, and other vegetables | 12% | 59 × 1.5 = 89 ml | 0.6 | 53 g | 45 | 24 kcal |
| Brown sauce, including cooking fat | 6% | 29 × 0.7 = 20 ml | 1.0 | 20 g | 150 | 30 kcal |
| Watermelon | 40% of bowl | 31 × 2.2 = 68 ml | 0.6 | 41 g | 30 | 12 kcal |
| Green grapes | 24% | 19 × 2.2 = 42 ml | 0.6 | 25 g | 69 | 17 kcal |
| Strawberries | 10% | 8 × 2.2 = 18 ml | 0.6 | 10 g | 32 | 3 kcal |
| Dark grapes or berries | 6% | 5 × 2.0 = 10 ml | 0.6 | 6 g | 55 | 3 kcal |
| Orange juice | Cup filled portion | Approximately 300 ml | 1.0 | 300 g | 45 | 135 kcal |

**Coverage check:** main plate **60%**, fruit bowl **80%**. No additional air-gap reduction has been applied.

### 8. Sanity check
The main dish totals approximately **365 g**, consistent with the moderately sized central pile. Fruit adds **82 g**, and juice **300 g**. Estimated total: **747 g and 652 kcal**, including the drink. Sauce composition is the largest energy uncertainty.
